mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market and robust economic activity, leading to stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive equity returns over a 5-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply contractions (industrial production decline), manufacturing slowdowns reduce corporate output and profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over a 60-day period.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading exceeding 3.0% YoY triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Continuous growth in non-farm payrolls indicates expanding economic activity and rising corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over a 5-day trading window.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1350.0 thousand units signal strong residential construction and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1350.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and rising federal funds rates indicate a monetary tightening cycle, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
